[EN] I guard the Garrison Commander's Residence at the request of the Velika Garrison. I was asked to keep anyone from entering this residence, so I'm not sure what brings you here, but I can't let anyone in. Not even you, . Just continue on to wherever you were going.
[ES] Guarno la residencia del Garrison Commander a petición de la Velika Garrison. Me pidieron que impidiera la entrada de cualquiera a esta residencia, así que no sé qué te trae por aquí, pero no puedo dejar entrar a nadie. Ni siquiera a ti, . Solo continúa hacia donde ibas.
